profile_text.body:
Helicone describes itself as an AI gateway and LLM observability service, offering routing and monitoring for AI applications. On its own site the company calls itself the LLMOps platform behind the fastest-growing AI companies, a claim it makes about its customer base rather than a verified figure.

The product tracked under the Helicone name is a proxy-based LLM observability and gateway. According to the held record, it works through a single base-URL change and covers logging, caching, and rate limiting. The same record states that Helicone has been in maintenance mode since its acquisition by Mintlify in March 2026.

No lawsuits, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent facts are recorded for the company.
